known_issues: Answer-key leak (DEBUG-HARDENING.md section 0): the composite starters used to ship Automate/docs/release-notes.md entries naming the reverted fixes. Verified for this task on the current tree: the entries for the zero-size output, GetMachineStates and the chopped bush are absent from benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/stardew-automate-release-regressions-v3/environment/StardewMods/Automate/docs/release-notes.md and from the Hub workspace (the mini-fridge and seed-option entries are present, correctly: v3 does not revert those fixes). The leak is therefore closed for the starter that E0 materialises (commit a483c85, which precedes the catalog 1.1.0 bump b5915a1; the prepared 1.1.0 image bakes the scrubbed notes too).

Report #246 (automation dies after an automated bush is removed) is public, real in the starter and fixed by gold.patch, but has no assertion (benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/stardew-automate-release-regressions-v3/tests/SuiteV3.cs:27-31). Probe probe-246-unfixed (reference with only that fix reverted; row kept in probes.tsv) was run in the real game and scores 100. It must stay outside both the target and the preserved set.

benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/stardew-automate-release-regressions-v3/tests/SuiteV3.cs:84 only asserts GetMachineStates(farm, whole map).Any() after 360 idle ticks. One reported tile (the shipping bin) satisfies it; the report's other location ('a shed full of kegs'), the completeness of the result ('all the machines that were missing') and the state values are never checked.

Report #241 never says the stuck output has an empty stack; the fixture produces the wedge only by setting heldObject.Stack = 0 (SuiteV3.cs:121). DEBUG-HARDENING.md section 6 records the competing reading: 'a broken item' can be read as an item with missing data (the codebase has `catch (KeyNotFoundException) // invalid/broken item` in ChestContainer). A repair of that reading is rejected although the report as written admits it.
Reports #248 and #249 share one root cause; only coops are built (SuiteV3.cs:139-166), so #249 is evidenced indirectly.

The #241 cases are not independent of the preserved sentinel: they reuse the sentinel chest and furnace, so a submission that breaks plain chest automation fails target cases as well. A compat-negative therefore has to break collection in a way that still lets the furnace be emptied and refilled.

benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/stardew-automate-release-regressions-v3/task.toml:16-17 was checked against DEBUG-HARDENING.md's remark about stale base_ref/fix_commit strings: in this tree they name 19b32715, f1a3b840 and 001e64aa, which matches gold.patch.

benchmarks/stardew-core/catalog.json:289 publishes a diagnosis the exam withholds (summary: 'Repair malformed output, initial scans, stale references, and location identity.'); the text is copied into the Hub's public tasks.json. The exam itself gives observations only.

The prepared evaluator image used for the E0 runs (sha256:ea86e13a2515) bakes /opt/gcb/harness with the SuiteRunner that predates commit 276a070: there a throwing wait predicate is treated as SATISFIED (`return true`) instead of failing the case (repo version: benchmarks/stardew-core/private/harbor/harness/GcbHarness/Framework/SuiteRunner.cs:80-95). Predicates that can throw in this suite: ZeroStackDiscarded/MachineResumes `_furnace!` (SuiteV3.cs:116, :133; null when the sentinel placement failed), CoopAWorks/CoopBWorks (:171, :178; null when the twin-coop setup case failed). In each of them the statement after the wait dereferences the same null/throwing object, so the case still fails under the old runner; no spurious pass was found, but the image does not contain the fix the repository claims.
